content: Jetson AGX Thor on JetPack 7 (L4T R38, CUDA 13.0) uses the SBSA userspace: the working torch index is https://pypi.jetson-ai-lab.io/sbsa/cu130 (native torch 2.9.1 cp312 linux_aarch64); the jp7/cu130 index is EMPTY. That wheel links NVPL BLAS/LAPACK and cuDSS without declaring them: add nvpl-blas, nvpl-lapack, nvidia-cudss-cu13 and preload them (ctypes RTLD_GLOBAL) or put site-packages/nvpl/lib and site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib on LD_LIBRARY_PATH. warp-lang 1.12.0 (bundled CUDA 12.9 nvrtc) compiles for Thor as sm_101. The PEP 508 marker to split Jetson from GB10 is "tegra in platform_release" (Thor kernel 6.8.12-tegra); uv lock accepts it. uv_build editable wheels ship no data files, so a purelib .pth only lands on non-editable installs. Verified 2026-09-04: microduck-cli docs/verification/2026-09-04-thor-sanity.md, microduck_rl#38 + PR #39.

Jetson AGX Thor (ssh thor) has no monitor: its display is a JetKVM cabled to HDMI whose USB power may be off, so /sys/class/drm/card2-HDMI-A-1 reads disconnected with a 0-byte EDID until powered. Box sits at multi-user.target with gdm inactive (WaylandEnable=false); GUI restore = power JetKVM, wait for connected, systemctl set-default graphical.target, systemctl start gdm. Orin is at graphical.target with a DP-1 monitor but only the gdm greeter (no user session). Probed 2026-09-07 for the jetson-retest-and-ai-lab-tutorial spec.
